verses.greek: Ταῦτα εἰπὼν Ἰησοῦς ἐξῆλθεν σὺν τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ πέραν τοῦ χειμάρρου τοῦ Κεδρὼν ὅπου ἦν κῆπος, εἰς ὃν εἰσῆλθεν αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ.
verses.literal: These things having said Jesus went out with the disciples of Him beyond the winter stream of the of Kidron where there was a garden into which entered He himself and the disciples of Him.
verses.dgt: After saying these things, Jesus went out with his disciples across the Kidron ravine, where there was a garden, which he and his disciples entered.

verses.greek: ᾔδει δὲ καὶ Ἰούδας ὁ παραδιδοὺς αὐτὸν τὸν τόπον, ὅτι πολλάκις συνήχθη Ἰησοῦς ἐκεῖ μετὰ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ.
verses.literal: Knew now also Judas who is delivering up Him the place because often gathered together Jesus there with the disciples of Him.
verses.dgt: Now Judas, who was betraying him, also knew the place, because Jesus had often gathered there with his disciples.

verses.greek: ὁ οὖν Ἰούδας λαβὼν τὴν σπεῖραν καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἀρχιερέων καὶ ἐκ τῶν Φαρισαίων ὑπηρέτας ἔρχεται ἐκεῖ μετὰ φανῶν καὶ λαμπάδων καὶ ὅπλων.
verses.literal: the Therefore Judas having procured the cohort and from the chief priests and from the Pharisees officers comes there with lanterns and torches and weapons.
verses.dgt: So Judas, having taken the cohort and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, comes there with lanterns and torches and weapons.

verses.greek: Ἰησοῦς οὖν εἰδὼς πάντα τὰ ἐρχόμενα ἐπʼ αὐτὸν ἐξῆλθεν, καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς· Τίνα ζητεῖτε;
verses.literal: Jesus therefore knowing all things that are coming upon Him he went out also speaks to them Whom seek you?
verses.dgt: Then Jesus, knowing all the things coming upon him, went out and says to them, “Whom are you seeking?”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτῷ· Ἰησοῦν τὸν Ναζωραῖον. λέγει αὐτοῖς· Ἐγώ εἰμι. εἱστήκει δὲ καὶ Ἰούδας ὁ παραδιδοὺς αὐτὸν μετʼ αὐτῶν.
verses.literal: They answered to Him Jesus the of Nazareth. He says to them I myself am He. Had been standing now also Judas who is delivering up Him with them.
verses.dgt: They answered him, “Jesus the Nazarene.” He says to them, “I am he.” Judas, who was betraying him, was also standing with them.

verses.greek: ὡς οὖν εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Ἐγώ εἰμι, ἀπῆλθον εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω καὶ ἔπεσαν χαμαί.
verses.literal: When therefore He said to them I myself am He they drew toward the back and fell to the ground.
verses.dgt: So when he said to them, “I am he,” they drew back and fell to the ground.

verses.greek: πάλιν οὖν ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτούς· Τίνα ζητεῖτε; οἱ δὲ εἶπαν· Ἰησοῦν τὸν Ναζωραῖον.
verses.literal: Again therefore He questioned them: Whom seek you? the And they said Jesus the of Nazareth.
verses.dgt: Then he asked them again, “Whom are you seeking?” And they said, “Jesus the Nazarene.”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς· Εἶπον ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι· εἰ οὖν ἐμὲ ζητεῖτε, ἄφετε τούτους ὑπάγειν·
verses.literal: Answered Jesus I have told you that I myself am He. If therefore Me myself you seek do allow these to go away
verses.dgt: Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he. So if you are seeking me, let these men go,”

verses.greek: ἵνα πληρωθῇ ὁ λόγος ὃν εἶπεν ὅτι Οὓς δέδωκάς μοι οὐκ ἀπώλεσα ἐξ αὐτῶν οὐδένα.
verses.literal: so that may be fulfilled the word that He had spoken that Those whom You have given Me not I lost of them not one.
verses.dgt: so that the word he had spoken might be fulfilled: “Of those whom you have given me, I lost not one.”

verses.greek: Σίμων οὖν Πέτρος ἔχων μάχαιραν εἵλκυσεν αὐτὴν καὶ ἔπαισεν τὸν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως δοῦλον καὶ ἀπέκοψεν αὐτοῦ τὸ ὠτάριον τὸ δεξιόν. ἦν δὲ ὄνομα τῷ δούλῳ Μάλχος.
verses.literal: Simon then Peter having a sword drew it and he struck the of the high priest servant and cut off of him the ear the right Was now name of the servant Malchus.
verses.dgt: Then Simon Peter, having a sword, drew it and struck the high priest’s slave and cut off his right ear. The slave’s name was Malchus.

verses.greek: εἶπεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τῷ Πέτρῳ· Βάλε τὴν μάχαιραν εἰς τὴν θήκην· τὸ ποτήριον ὃ δέδωκέν μοι ὁ πατὴρ οὐ μὴ πίω αὐτό;
verses.literal: Said therefore the Jesus the to Peter do put the sword into the sheath. The cup which has given Me the Father certainly surely shall I drink it?
verses.dgt: So Jesus said to Peter, “Put the sword into the sheath. The cup that the Father has given me—shall I certainly not drink it?”

verses.greek: Ἡ οὖν σπεῖρα καὶ ὁ χιλίαρχος καὶ οἱ ὑπηρέται τῶν Ἰουδαίων συνέλαβον τὸν Ἰησοῦν καὶ ἔδησαν αὐτὸν
verses.literal: the Then the cohort and the commander and the officers of the Jews took hold of the Jesus and bound Him
verses.dgt: Then the cohort, the commander, and the officers of the Jews arrested Jesus and bound him,

verses.greek: καὶ ἤγαγον πρὸς Ἅνναν πρῶτον· ἦν γὰρ πενθερὸς τοῦ Καϊάφα, ὃς ἦν ἀρχιερεὺς τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ ἐκείνου·
verses.literal: and they brought away to Annas first he was for father-in-law the of Caiaphas who was high priest on the year same.
verses.dgt: and they led him first to Annas, for he was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.

verses.greek: ἦν δὲ Καϊάφας ὁ συμβουλεύσας τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις ὅτι συμφέρει ἕνα ἄνθρωπον ἀποθανεῖν ὑπὲρ τοῦ λαοῦ.
verses.literal: Was now Caiaphas the one having given counsel to the Jews that it is profitable for one man to die for the people.
verses.dgt: Now Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jews that it was better for one man to die for the people.

verses.greek: Ἠκολούθει δὲ τῷ Ἰησοῦ Σίμων Πέτρος καὶ ἄλλος μαθητής. ὁ δὲ μαθητὴς ἐκεῖνος ἦν γνωστὸς τῷ ἀρχιερεῖ καὶ συνεισῆλθεν τῷ Ἰησοῦ εἰς τὴν αὐλὴν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως,
verses.literal: Were following now the after Jesus Simon Peter and other disciple. the Now disciple that one was known to the high priest also he entered with the Jesus into the court of the high priest.
verses.dgt: Simon Peter and another disciple were following Jesus. That disciple was known to the high priest and entered with Jesus into the high priest’s courtyard,

verses.greek: ὁ δὲ Πέτρος εἱστήκει πρὸς τῇ θύρᾳ ἔξω. ἐξῆλθεν οὖν ὁ μαθητὴς ὁ ἄλλος ὁ γνωστὸς τοῦ ἀρχιερέως καὶ εἶπεν τῇ θυρωρῷ καὶ εἰσήγαγεν τὸν Πέτρον.
verses.literal: the But Peter had stood at the door outside. Went out therefore the disciple the other who known to the high priest and spoke to the doorkeeper and brought in the Peter.
verses.dgt: but Peter was standing outside at the door. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to the doorkeeper and brought Peter in.

verses.greek: λέγει οὖν τῷ Πέτρῳ ἡ παιδίσκη ἡ θυρωρός· Μὴ καὶ σὺ ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν εἶ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τούτου; λέγει ἐκεῖνος· Οὐκ εἰμί.
verses.literal: Says therefore the to Peter the servant girl the doorkeeper: Surely also you yourself of the disciples are of the man this? Says he Not I am.
verses.dgt: Then the servant girl who kept the door says to Peter, “You are not also one of this man’s disciples, are you?” He says, “I am not.”

verses.greek: εἱστήκεισαν δὲ οἱ δοῦλοι καὶ οἱ ὑπηρέται ἀνθρακιὰν πεποιηκότες, ὅτι ψῦχος ἦν, καὶ ἐθερμαίνοντο· ἦν δὲ καὶ ὁ Πέτρος μετʼ αὐτῶν ἑστὼς καὶ θερμαινόμενος.
verses.literal: Had been standing now the servants and the officers a fire of coals having made for cold it was and they were warming themselves Was now also the Peter with them having stood and warming himself.
verses.dgt: Now the slaves and officers had made a charcoal fire because it was cold, and they were warming themselves. Peter also was standing with them and warming himself.

verses.greek: Ὁ οὖν ἀρχιερεὺς ἠρώτησεν τὸν Ἰησοῦν περὶ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ περὶ τῆς διδαχῆς αὐτοῦ.
verses.literal: the Then the high priest questioned the Jesus concerning the disciples of Him and concerning the teaching of Him.
verses.dgt: So the high priest questioned Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ Ἰησοῦς· Ἐγὼ παρρησίᾳ λελάληκα τῷ κόσμῳ· ἐγὼ πάντοτε ἐδίδαξα ἐν συναγωγῇ καὶ ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ, ὅπου πάντες οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι συνέρχονται, καὶ ἐν κρυπτῷ ἐλάλησα οὐδέν·
verses.literal: Answered to him Jesus I myself openly have spoken to the world. I myself always taught in synagogue and in the temple where all the Jews come together and in secret I spoke not anything.
verses.dgt: Jesus answered him, “I have spoken openly to the world. I always taught in a synagogue and in the temple, where all the Jews gather, and I spoke nothing in secret.

verses.greek: τί με ἐρωτᾷς; ἐρώτησον τοὺς ἀκηκοότας τί ἐλάλησα αὐτοῖς· ἴδε οὗτοι οἴδασιν ἃ εἶπον ἐγώ.
verses.literal: Why Me do you ask? do ask those having heard what I spoke to them. behold they know what said I myself.
verses.dgt: Why do you question me? Question those who have heard what I spoke to them. Look, they know what I said.”

verses.greek: ταῦτα δὲ αὐτοῦ εἰπόντος εἷς παρεστηκὼς τῶν ὑπηρετῶν ἔδωκεν ῥάπισμα τῷ Ἰησοῦ εἰπών· Οὕτως ἀποκρίνῃ τῷ ἀρχιερεῖ;
verses.literal: These things now of Him having said one already standing by of the officers gave a blow with the palm the to Jesus having said Thus answer You to the high priest?
verses.dgt: When he said these things, one of the officers standing by gave Jesus a slap, saying, “Is that how you answer the high priest?”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ Ἰησοῦς· Εἰ κακῶς ἐλάλησα, μαρτύρησον περὶ τοῦ κακοῦ· εἰ δὲ καλῶς, τί με δέρεις;
verses.literal: Answered to him Jesus If evil I spoke do bear witness concerning the evil if however rightly why Me strike you?
verses.dgt: Jesus answered him, “If I spoke wrongly, testify about the wrong; but if rightly, why do you hit me?”

verses.greek: ἀπέστειλεν οὖν αὐτὸν ὁ Ἅννας δεδεμένον πρὸς Καϊάφαν τὸν ἀρχιερέα.
verses.literal: Sent then Him the Annas bound to Caiaphas the high priest.
verses.dgt: Then Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas the high priest.

verses.greek: Ἦν δὲ Σίμων Πέτρος ἑστὼς καὶ θερμαινόμενος. εἶπον οὖν αὐτῷ· Μὴ καὶ σὺ ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ εἶ; ἠρνήσατο ἐκεῖνος καὶ εἶπεν· Οὐκ εἰμί.
verses.literal: Was now Simon Peter already standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him Surely also you yourself of the disciples of Him are? Denied he and said Not I am.
verses.dgt: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. So they said to him, “You are not also one of his disciples, are you?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”

verses.greek: λέγει εἷς ἐκ τῶν δούλων τοῦ ἀρχιερέως, συγγενὴς ὢν οὗ ἀπέκοψεν Πέτρος τὸ ὠτίον· Οὐκ ἐγώ σε εἶδον ἐν τῷ κήπῳ μετʼ αὐτοῦ;
verses.literal: Says one of the servants of the high priest kinsman being of him of whom cut off Peter the ear Surely I myself you saw in the garden with Him?
verses.dgt: One of the high priest’s slaves, a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, says, “Did I not see you in the garden with him?”

verses.greek: πάλιν οὖν ἠρνήσατο Πέτρος· καὶ εὐθέως ἀλέκτωρ ἐφώνησεν.
verses.literal: Again then denied Peter and immediately a rooster crowed.
verses.dgt: Then Peter denied it again, and immediately a rooster crowed.

verses.greek: Ἄγουσιν οὖν τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἀπὸ τοῦ Καϊάφα εἰς τὸ πραιτώριον· ἦν δὲ πρωΐ· καὶ αὐτοὶ οὐκ εἰσῆλθον εἰς τὸ πραιτώριον, ἵνα μὴ μιανθῶσιν ἀλλὰ φάγωσιν τὸ πάσχα.
verses.literal: They are leading then the Jesus from the Caiaphas into the Praetorium It was now early. and they themselves not entered into the Praetorium so that not they may be defiled but may eat the Passover.
verses.dgt: So they lead Jesus from Caiaphas to the governor’s headquarters. It was early morning. They themselves did not enter the headquarters so that they would not be defiled, but could eat the Passover.

verses.greek: ἐξῆλθεν οὖν ὁ Πιλᾶτος ἔξω πρὸς αὐτοὺς καὶ φησίν· Τίνα κατηγορίαν φέρετε κατὰ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τούτου;
verses.literal: Went therefore the Pilate out to them and said What accusation bring you against the man this?
verses.dgt: So Pilate came outside to them and says, “What accusation do you bring against this man?”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθησαν καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ· Εἰ μὴ ἦν οὗτος κακὸν ποιῶν, οὐκ ἄν σοι παρεδώκαμεν αὐτόν.
verses.literal: They answered and they said to him only except were He evil doing then not would to you we have delivered Him.
verses.dgt: They answered and said to him, “If this man were not doing evil, we would not have handed him over to you.”

verses.greek: εἶπεν οὖν αὐτοῖς ὁ Πιλᾶτος· Λάβετε αὐτὸν ὑμεῖς, καὶ κατὰ τὸν νόμον ὑμῶν κρίνατε αὐτόν. εἶπον αὐτῷ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι· Ἡμῖν οὐκ ἔξεστιν ἀποκτεῖναι οὐδένα·
verses.literal: Said therefore to them the Pilate do take Him yourselves and according to the law of you do judge Him. Said to him the Jews To us not it is permitted to put to death no one
verses.dgt: So Pilate said to them, “Take him yourselves and judge him according to your law.” The Jews said to him, “It is not lawful for us to kill anyone,”

verses.greek: ἵνα ὁ λόγος τοῦ Ἰησοῦ πληρωθῇ ὃν εἶπεν σημαίνων ποίῳ θανάτῳ ἤμελλεν ἀποθνῄσκειν.
verses.literal: that the word the of Jesus may be fulfilled which He had spoken signifying as what death He was about to die.
verses.dgt: so that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled that he had spoken, indicating by what kind of death he was going to die.

verses.greek: Εἰσῆλθεν οὖν πάλιν εἰς τὸ πραιτώριον ὁ Πιλᾶτος καὶ ἐφώνησεν τὸν Ἰησοῦν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Σὺ εἶ ὁ βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων;
verses.literal: Entered therefore again into the Praetorium the Pilate and he called the Jesus and said to Him You yourself are the King of the Jews?
verses.dgt: Then Pilate entered the governor’s headquarters again, called Jesus, and said to him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς· Ἀπὸ σεαυτοῦ σὺ τοῦτο λέγεις ἢ ἄλλοι εἶπόν σοι περὶ ἐμοῦ;
verses.literal: Answered Jesus Of yourself you yourself this say or others did say it to you concerning Me?
verses.dgt: Jesus answered, “Are you saying this from yourself, or did others tell you about me?”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη ὁ Πιλᾶτος· Μήτι ἐγὼ Ἰουδαῖός εἰμι; τὸ ἔθνος τὸ σὸν καὶ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς παρέδωκάν σε ἐμοί· τί ἐποίησας;
verses.literal: Answered the Pilate surely not ever I myself a Jew am? The nation the of You and the chief priests delivered You to me myself What did You do?
verses.dgt: Pilate answered, “Am I a Jew? Your own nation and the chief priests handed you over to me. What did you do?”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς· Ἡ βασιλεία ἡ ἐμὴ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου τούτου· εἰ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου τούτου ἦν ἡ βασιλεία ἡ ἐμή, οἱ ὑπηρέται οἱ ἐμοὶ ἠγωνίζοντο ἄν, ἵνα μὴ παραδοθῶ τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις· νῦν δὲ ἡ βασιλεία ἡ ἐμὴ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐντεῦθεν.
verses.literal: Answered Jesus The kingdom the of Mine not is of the world this if of the world this were the kingdom the of Mine the attendants the of Mine they were fighting then would that not I may be betrayed to the Jews Now however the kingdom the of Mine not is from here.
verses.dgt: Jesus answered, “My kingdom is not from this world. If my kingdom were from this world, my servants would have fought so that I would not be handed over to the Jews. But now my kingdom is not from here.”

verses.greek: εἶπεν οὖν αὐτῷ ὁ Πιλᾶτος· Οὐκοῦν βασιλεὺς εἶ σύ; ἀπεκρίθη ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Σὺ λέγεις ὅτι βασιλεύς εἰμι. ἐγὼ εἰς τοῦτο γεγέννημαι καὶ εἰς τοῦτο ἐλήλυθα εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἵνα μαρτυρήσω τῇ ἀληθείᾳ· πᾶς ὁ ὢν ἐκ τῆς ἀληθείας ἀκούει μου τῆς φωνῆς.
verses.literal: Said therefore to Him the Pilate Then a king are You yourself? Answered the Jesus You yourself say that a king am I myself. for this have been born and for this I have come into the world that I may bear witness to the truth. Everyone who is being of the truth hears My the voice.
verses.dgt: So Pilate said to him, “Then you are a king?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this I have been born, and for this I have come into the world: that I may testify to the truth. Everyone who is from the truth hears my voice.”

verses.greek: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Πιλᾶτος· Τί ἐστιν ἀλήθεια; Καὶ τοῦτο εἰπὼν πάλιν ἐξῆλθεν πρὸς τοὺς Ἰουδαίους, καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς· Ἐγὼ οὐδεμίαν εὑρίσκω ἐν αὐτῷ αἰτίαν·
verses.literal: Says to Him the Pilate What is truth? And this having said again he went out to the Jews and says to them I myself no thing find in Him guilt.
verses.dgt: Pilate says to him, “What is truth?” And after saying this, he went outside again to the Jews and says to them, “I find no charge in him.

verses.greek: ἔστιν δὲ συνήθεια ὑμῖν ἵνα ἕνα ἀπολύσω ὑμῖν ἐν τῷ πάσχα· βούλεσθε οὖν ⸄ἀπολύσω ὑμῖν⸅ τὸν βασιλέα τῶν Ἰουδαίων;
verses.literal: It is however a custom with you that one I may release to you at the Passover wish you therefore I may release to you the King of the Jews?
verses.dgt: But you have a custom that I release one person to you at the Passover. So do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”

verses.greek: ἐκραύγασαν οὖν πάλιν λέγοντες· Μὴ τοῦτον ἀλλὰ τὸν Βαραββᾶν. ἦν δὲ ὁ Βαραββᾶς λῃστής.
verses.literal: They cried out then again saying Not this one but the Barabbas! Was now the Barabbas an insurrectionist.
verses.dgt: Then they cried out again, saying, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.
